threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still cross Kingsland Road at the pedestrian lights instead of just going for it. The locals don’t even look up anymore.
Last night on the 59, a bloke argued with the driver about the route. Turns out he was trying to get to Clapham Junction but just wouldn't listen. Classic!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was living here when the corner Kiosk ran out of currywurst at 3 AM and we all just laughed it off like it was normal.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you grab a döner at 3 AM and watch a spontaneous techno party break out in the park next door. Just another night!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their casual disdain for the BART delays—only a true San Franciscan rolls their eyes at train chaos like it's a daily coffee break.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy last week at the 6th and Market stop in a full tuxedo serenading a pigeon. The bird was not impressed, but the crowd loved it.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the squares and bars, but they miss the daily hustle at the Mercat de la Llibertat, where locals actually shop.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always spot newcomers by their hesitation at the La Boqueria's entrance—too polite to elbow their way for a jamón sandwich.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a kebab shop instead of a 'kebab house'. The locals are quick to correct you after a late night out.
Caught a night bus last week, and there was a guy singing opera. Half the passengers were filming him, while the other half just pretended it wasn’t happening.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a group of kids setting up a makeshift cinema in the park with a projector and blankets, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you catch a U-Bahn strike and still grab some currywurst from a busker selling it out of a tent. Pure Berlin magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they can name all the taco trucks on Mission from 16th to 24th without missing a beat. Tourists just stick to the first one they see.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: The other day, a guy serenaded the 38 with a ukulele and a heartbreaking rendition of 'Somewhere Over the Rainbow.' Feel like that sums up Muni perfectly.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the 'local' shops are all in Plaça del Sol; they miss the real gems hidden down Carrer de L'Encarnació, like that tiny bookstore.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their baffled expression while staring at the bus map in Gràcia, still expecting it to make sense.
